facts.fact: 叙述者 Namid 与表亲 June Bug、Ziib 常在 Gichigami 湖边互相讲水怪故事取乐，但没人敢独自走进夜里的湖。
facts.anchor: Though we pretended to scoff, no one went into the night lake alone.

facts.fact: 大湖干涸后天气成了新的恐慌源头：十五小时暴雨、泥石流推倒游客房屋，苏必利尔湖变成吞没家具与移民者面孔的坟场。
传说里的水下黑豹 Mishibizhii 从神话洞穴中走出来，四肢不断变长，越变越大。
facts.anchor: Mishibizhii walked slowly from the mythic caverns where he had once made his home.

facts.fact: 部落女子 Cold Shell 与 Lu 身着 ribbon skirt 舞向巨兽；Lu 敲着手鼓唱歌，Mishibizhii 低头闻她的头发后，用角刺穿了她的腹部。
facts.anchor: a single sharp horn pierced the soft flesh of Lu’s belly.

facts.fact: Namid 放哨时几乎举枪自杀，随后发现自己倒在地上，手里握着的手枪变成了一个 makwa（熊）药袋。
facts.anchor: in the hand that had held the pistol was a medicine bag.

facts.fact: Ziib 跌进为巨兽挖的尖刺陷阱，腿上缠着染血的布条，仍开玩笑自称 Tarzan。
facts.anchor: Cloth strips that bound his leg at knee level bore the mark of dried blood.

facts.fact: 母亲 Mikwam 在族会上提议去与 Windigo（恶赌徒）交配，想生一个能赶走巨兽的孩子。
Namid 无法接受母亲要成为「通奸者」的计划，当场干呕并晕了过去。
facts.anchor: asking for permission to mate with what had previously been the most evil being any of us could imagine.

facts.fact: 结尾点题：最可怕的怪物不是 Mishibizhii，而是「谁该为谁牺牲」这类无解的大问题。
facts.anchor: But the most terrible monster any of us met in those years or these came in the form of the big unanswerable questions.
